name: 02_native_two_queries_combine
description: Two agent-written queries; the agent combines them with recorded DuckDB SQL.

queries.text: SELECT c.region, SUM(f.net_amount) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 'FY27-Q1' GROUP BY c.region

SELECT c.region, SUM(f.net_amount) AS revenue_py FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 'FY26-Q1' GROUP BY c.region

then_complete.sql:
SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(revenue_py) AS revenue_py
FROM (SELECT * FROM actuals UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM prior)
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
